name: Cascadia
quote: Hers is the responsibility of safeguarding lives from disaster.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Mornin'! Want to join me for morning training? Good thing I prepared an extra breakfast. Here you go. Don't forget to replenish your energy on time.

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text:
(Yawn)
H-Hey, don't look at me like that! It's only natural to yawn when you're on lunch break! Why don't you put your work aside for a bit and take a break, too? I mean, preparing well for a job makes it go quicker, right?

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: A children's set meal again—what the heck?! Are they treating me like a kid again? Hm... It tastes pretty good, though. Maybe I'll order it again next time...

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: Are you still working at this hour? Honestly, you should really take care of your health. Anything I can help with? You should get some rest once it's done.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: Ew, what's this... It's coffee? It's bitter and sweet and nothing at all like energy drinks. Those taste great, go down easily and can even replenish your energy! I've had pretty much every major brand of energy drink on the market—which would you like to try?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: "Slo-Mo's" a good kid, he's well trained, solid and reliable. Maybe he's had to trade a bit of agility for that, but he's a real beast once he gets to work!

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Professor... Professor? So you're asleep, huh... Let's get you covered up with a blanket.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: This is my tool bag, this is my wireless power transmitter, this is my infrared imager... All these tools are my pride and joy, and I bought most of them myself. Thanks to them, I've managed to save more people than I could otherwise. I've got a good eye, don't I?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Hm? These scratches on my goggles? Hehe~ They're a badge of honor for me.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: This is pretty heavy, can you lift it?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Hey, no pushing!

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: I'm on duty? It counts as a sort of rest, I suppose.

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: I'm Cascadia, an emergency rescuer. Don't underestimate me. I'm no mere team mascot.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: Soon... I'll break through my limits!

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: I'll be able to save more people this way, right?

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: Equipment's working, vital signs are stable... This is the signal of life, can you hear it?

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Keep up, "Slo-Mo".

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: We're heading out. Everyone, mind your feet!

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Electric Breaker!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: Told you, didn't I? Don't look down on shorties.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: Rescue complete!

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: Just... a little more...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text: What's this? Is it a new contract? ...An oath? This... I... Ahhhh, it's the real thing! You know you can't just casually bring this sort of thing up, right? No takebacks either, you know? No takebacks, ever! Honestly, I just can't relax around you... Alright then, I accept. From now on, no matter when or where it happens, if you're ever in danger, call my name, and I'll be there.

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: Happy New Year, Professor. The start of a new year is like the start of a new phase in an operation; you can think about what sort of plans and wishes you'll have this year. Huh? Me? I, uh, I don't really have any wishes! Well, it would be nice if I were a little taller...

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: Ehhh? Professor?! It's okay, calm down, nothing happened here! I wasn't really thinking when I set up this warning tape... Ah! Dammit, I messed it up again! I got careless and used too much force. Who would have thought making chocolate for the Professor was so difficult...

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: Tanabata? I've heard of it before. It's a really romantic occasion in the East, right? I heard that it's about couples climbing a bridge made of birds to meet each other. Hm... That sounds like a really unstable structure! Here, take this radio, Professor. Contact me if you need me, and I'll be right there.

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: Professor, Happy Hallo... Hm? Candy? No, I'm not here for treats! (Nom) Okay, so they DO taste good... Wait a minute, I almost forgot why I was looking for you! Anyway, notice anything new? Hehe, I smeared ketchup on my demolition hammer and Slo-Mo's chainsaw blade. Cool, huh? Let's go give everyone a "surprise"! Oh right, you're playing the corpse!

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: It's Christmas again, and seeing everyone climbing to high places to decorate Christmas trees makes me nervous... I mean, the festive ornaments look really pretty, but climbing to high places without being properly secured is very unsafe. Ah! Things look bad over there. I'm going to take a look!

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: Happy birthday, Professor. In the past, when I was still on a rescue team, I didn't know how important "birthdays" were. Later on, one of the people I rescued told me that you should properly celebrate birthdays by eating a special kind of noodle! So I tried making a bowl of them for you; want to give it a taste? It might not look too good... but it still tastes good, right?

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud.

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text: Professor, be careful—Uwah, that scared the crap out of me. Demolition hammers are really dangerous, you know! I'm maintaining my personal items, so they're spread out on the ground. You think they look heavy? They're just right for me, though. One of my former team members took one without telling me for kicks, and he ended up in hospital for three months! What, you scared? Hehe, then you'd better pay attention to my explanations. Equipment that can save people in emergencies can hurt others when misused! If you need to use one of these tools, just let me know and I'll help you out.

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text:
Huh? Yeah, that's right, I converted my dorm into a maintenance bay—but, but this is MY dorm! I didn't break down any walls or anything. Heck, I even reinforced them! Are you asking about this because you're going to... Eh? You just wanted to make sure? Ah, that's okay, then. You should have said so earlier! I'm good at this stuff; if you need lessons on how to maintain machinery, you can look me up anytime!
Well, the truth is that at first, I just wanted to set up a recharging and repair dock for Slo-Mo. He's an important friend of mine, so I can't just have him sleep on the ground beside my bed. That'd be just like an ordinary dog, right? Mhm, you agree too, don't you? I like that you're pretty reasonable; that's way better than some of my former teammates. Life here... It feels pretty good, yeah.

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
Professor? So you were here, too... The weather's great, isn't it? I didn't expect the Oasis to actually have a weather simulation system; that's a really decadent use of operands! Ahhh, no, no, no, I never said it was a bad thing, don't make that face! Rather, I should say I actually like how things are right now. Come on, sit down with me. It's not often that the "Ever-Busy" Professor has free time like this, right?
You see, whenever I went out on assignments in the real world, the weather was always bad... There were storms, mudslides, smoke, and just about everything that happened during that bad weather was annoying. That's why I have a soft spot for clear blue skies. You know, I have to say... the fact that you can manage the Oasis and keep it from becoming crowded and messy means you really are an amazing person.

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
You want to know why I'm being so sentimental about the Oasis? Hm... Well, I guess it won't hurt to tell you. You've seen my case files before, right? Yup, I'm a delinquent who disobeys orders. Well? Regret taking me in now?
Meh, you weren't scared at all. Yes, I disobeyed orders and ended up being grounded by my original team, then they kicked me over to another team before finally getting dumped in Project Neural Cloud. Makes me sound like the unpopular kid that nobody likes, right? Humph... I'll tell you, they're all a bunch of stubborn blockheads who'd gladly let people die for the sake of palming responsibility off onto someone else or because they're playing petty politics. Anyone with an ounce of justice in their hearts would disobey the orders they gave! I just... I just... I just didn't want to see lives lost because of reasons like that.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text: Sometimes, I find myself thinking that if you'd been in charge of me, a lot more people would have survived instead of dying. All you need to do is make the call; just leave the professional work to me! And yes, I know it's risky, but... Well, SOMEONE has to do it. If there's a little ray of hope left, if there's one more person left to save, then I'll head straight for the frontlines to do my best there. This strange sense of righteousness has been with me from the beginning. Never mind where it came from, isn't it natural to cherish life? Even if it's just a base personality setting because I'm a rescue worker, doesn't that mean it's always been a part of me and something I can be proud of? Well, as long as you respect my judgment, I'll make sure I live up to your trust. Think you can do that, "Leader"?

career:
The SRT-8 emergency rescue Doll was developed by Svarog Heavy Industries. It was primarily intended for rescue and obstacle-clearing operations in earthquakes, floods, and other natural disasters. Due to being frequently deployed in highly hazardous environments, the SRT-8 was advertised with "reliable and durable" as a core marketing concept. Even after sustaining moderate damage, it could be re-deployed into use after simple repairs, a fact which earned it much acclaim from municipal and private emergency responder agencies. In addition, the SRT-8 featured a great deal of function expandability, allowing it to quickly swap or add necessary functional modules to suit the needs of their assignments, such as the ability to operate large electrical cutters, heavy engineering exoskeletons, and so on.

Cascadia began her service with the Federal Emergency Search and Rescue Agency in 2057, where she demonstrated a great deal of professional aptitude and saved many lives in multiple SAR operations. Following that, she was transferred to various other organizations, where she carried out more disaster relief missions, and in 2059, Cascadia was selected to join Project Neural Cloud.
infoStories:
As the name suggests, the SRT-8 is the 8th generation of the SRT series, which was originally developed in the 40s by the engineering company Gaterbillar as a multi-legged vehicle for use in disaster relief work. After WW3 broke out, Gaterbillar was acquired and restructured, and further development of the SRT line halted for a while. 2052 saw the introduction of the SRT-5, which was based on early military Doll frames. Although it was comparatively more versatile than its multi-legged vehicle ancestors, history would prove that the SRT-5 was overly adventurous and few people were willing to purchase it. Its successors, the SRT-6 and 7, corrected the flaws of their predecessors, and the SRT series once again regained its place of pride in the industry.

The SRT-8 was the first attempt at a "summary" design of all the improvements that had been made since the line had gone from multi-legged rescue walkers to Dolls. Thanks to improvements in mechanical engineering, the SRT-8 is more easily repaired than its predecessors and features an unprecedented degree of functional expandability. Ever since its rollout in 2057, the SRT-8 has enjoyed much commercial success.

The name "Cascadia" is derived from the geological region and plate subduction zone of the same name located off the Pacific Shore. It is famous for being an earthquake-prone region and the source of many geological terms. Captain Franklin of the Federal Emergency Search and Rescue Agency was born in the Cascadia region of Oregon, which had been devastated long ago by ELID. While it is said that he had given the newly-inducted SRT-8 Doll on his team this name due to her primary role and function, it is also possible he had done so out of longing for his long-vanished hometown.

Cascadia's first mission after entering service was an earthquake-wrecked village located deep in the mountains. Due to the great age of the homes there, the community had suffered severe damage despite the relatively low intensity of the temblor. Upon arriving on the scene of her maiden operation, Cascadia was shaken by the devastation wrought upon the landscape, and from then on she made up her mind; no matter how terrible the disaster before her, she would hold off the Grim Reaper as best as she could.

Shortly after entering service, Cascadia showed her immaturity in certain aspects. Her strong ego and convictions made her stand out in a paramilitary organization, and this was not always a good thing. She would get into disputes with her colleagues and even her superiors due to circumventing operational plans. At times, she would insist on doing things her own way and rely on her own experience and courage rather than plans prepared ahead of time. This was not viewed in a good light even though these improvisations had worked out for the best.

"I think it's better to obey orders and work carefully rather than rush in recklessly. That's the best way to avoid unforeseen complications," one of Cascadia's colleagues said about her in exasperation. "Still, she's always won her bets. Maybe that's because Dolls make their decisions with logic and reason as their guide."

After several incidents, Cascadia gradually became more cautious, but her tendency to work in bold yet measured ways never truly disappeared. Or rather, she became a little more mature, and everyone became more able to tolerate this quirk—or rather, this advantage—of hers.

Cascadia has many personal hobbies outside of work, and she is a textbook "machine otaku".

She spends her free time in the machine shop modifying and tinkering with various mechanical devices, including her bosom companion, the demolition mecha-hound called "Slo-Mo". Initially, "Slo-Mo" was only equipped with basic intelligence functions, but after repairs following severe damage in a rescue operation, Cascadia made an extremely simplified copy of her own neural cloud and grafted it onto "Slo-Mo". As a result, it became more intelligent, though occasionally a little disobedient. According to Cascadia, she and Slo-Mo, "are of one mind".

In addition, Cascadia is also skilled at less mainstream skills such as motorcycle and truck repair, radio modification and even outdoors cooking, which is a side of her that can only be gradually discovered after spending much time with her.

It is bleakly ironic that Cascadia immediately gained a chance to apply her "professional knowledge" upon arriving at the Oasis. When she saw the devastation wrought by the Entropic invasion—the same fallen buildings, cracked ground, and never-ending wails of the wounded that she had witnessed many times before in her career—she did not wait to be officially welcomed to the Oasis like most of her compatriots. Instead, she picked her way through the debris, crossing battlefields with her partner "Slo-Mo" and helped as many wounded as she could find along the way. Though she did not understand the full details of what was going on, such as "What are these Entropics?" and "What are the Exiles?", she still bore witness to the end of the ordeal that had befallen the Oasis.

Her welcome ceremony was simple and conducted in an emergency shelter. She had no complaints about it, however. After all, such places were like a home away from home to her. All she said was, "Aw, I just did what I could. Let's get along from now on!"

The agents she rescued gathered outside the shelter to thank their newly arrived helper.
"Thank you very much! What's your name?"
"Just call me Cascadia!"
oathDesc: Save more people with her in times of crisis.

projections.name: Treacherous Trek
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"She knew full well her duty allowed even a second of delay, and so she quickened her steps."

projections.name: Respite Amidst The Rubble
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"Betwixt the operations in all variety of peril she rested, joy and fatigue intertwining, sweat and dust fusing."

skinList.name: Blessing of the Sanguine Moon
skinList.desc:
Monsters prowl the old town under the hunter's moon. A heavy fog billows forth and danger lurks all around. Something terrifying roars and rumbles as it approaches, until the last survivor glimpses its true form—
"I followed the distress signal here to rescue you. Man, it was hard to find... Huh? Why are you looking at me like that?"
